Hi Sophie / Rajesh —

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to learn more about Acme's use cases around low-latency recommender inference and your upcoming SRE review. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Goal: 60-minute technical demo + architecture deep-dive focused on latency, batching, and KV cache behavior for your recommender pipeline.
- Attendees we recommend from our side: myself (AM), Camila (AE), Logan (Sales Eng).
- Questions you asked we’ll cover: 1) expected throughput at 1000 TPS, 2) model quantization tradeoffs, 3) deployment options (Dedicated vs Private).

Proposed times (all PT):
- Wed Mar 31 — 10:00–11:00am PT
- Thu Apr 1 — 2:00–3:00pm PT
- Fri Apr 2 — 9:00–10:00am PT

Can you confirm which of these works and who from your side will join (product/CTO/SRE)? I’ll send a calendar invite with Zoom and an agenda once we lock time.

Attached is a one-page mutual action plan so we can align on scope/topics (mutual-action-plan.pdf).

Thanks —
